last.verdict: Investors sold hard on a wider loss and a slower 737 production ramp.

reasons.label: 737 ramp slower
reasons.text: Boeing cut its 2026 737 delivery target; 52 jets a month now seen only late 2027.

reasons.label: Bigger loss than expected
reasons.text: Adjusted loss was $0.34 a share versus about $0.25 expected, with plane unit losing $697 million.

reasons.label: Cash recovery delayed
reasons.text: Free cash flow was only $0.5 billion; the year to date is still $359 million negative.

story: Boeing has stayed loss-making for a year. A $4.9 billion 777X charge hit the October 2025 report, and shares fell 3.3%. July's report beat on revenue and nudged shares up, but this one showed the 737 turnaround slipping.
